jobs.description: Who Are We? Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That’s the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it. Job Category Project Management Target Openings 1 What Is the Opportunity? The role requires a working command of the insurance value chain - how risk originates and flows from insured through retail broker, wholesale broker and MGA to carrier, where underwriting authority is held or delegated at each step. It requires an understanding of insurance financials: rate adequacy and loss ratio development, the acquisition cost stack, expense ratio drivers, and differing level of the capital intensity and volatility of a class. And it requires a commercial read on two markets that behave very differently - a subscription London Market shaped by Lloyd's oversight, lead and follow economics, facilities and delegated authority, and a retail market shaped by broker consolidation, carrier panel rationalisation, schemes and e-trade. We are looking for someone who brings that understanding on day one. This is a strategy advisory role, not programme, portfolio or transformation management. • Strategy Formulation: Provide leadership and hands-on support to deliver key strategic initiatives, including strategic reviews, market horizon scanning, competitor benchmarking, and market insight development. • Investment Framework: Shape the translation of strategy into a set of investment priorities that advance Travelers Europe’s market offering, capabilities, and operating model. Provide strategic insight to inform investment prioritisation and ensure alignment with business strategy objectives. • Strategy Communications: Provide leadership on clear and effective communication of Travelers Europe’s business strategy, working with Corporate Communications and business stakeholders to ensure visibility of strategic priorities, progress, and outcomes. • Performance Framework: Establish and mature performance frameworks including OKRs and KPIs, to monitor strategic progress, drive accountability, and support disciplined execution across priority initiatives. • Strategic leader and critical thinker with a pragmatic, commercially minded leadership approach. • Trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, skilled at navigating ambiguity, shaping strategic priorities, and building consensus with senior stakeholders. • Highly proactive, resilient, and tenacious in driving progress across complex initiatives and maintaining momentum through challenge or uncertainty. • Operates with significant autonomy and sound judgement, while knowing when to engage, influence, or escalate appropriately. • Embodies Travelers’ values through integrity, innovation, customer focus, and a clear commitment to commercial outcomes. Preferred Qualification s • Degree in Business, Economics, Strategy, Finance, or a related discipline. • Understanding of the London and European insurance markets, including regulatory frameworks, customer and distribution trends, and competitive dynamics. • Experience in corporate strategy, business transformation, strategic planning, or a related discipline within a complex, multi-line organisation. • Experience working with executive stakeholders and cross-functional teams to align activity around shared strategic objectives. • Strong financial and analytical acumen, with the ability to assess portfolio performance, growth opportunities, investment priorities, and key performance metrics. • Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts and translate analysis into clear, compelling insight for diverse audiences. • Experience working across geographies and cultures, ideally within a global financial services or insurance organisation. Minimum Qualifications • Relevant strategy leadership experience, including proven success in corporate strategy, management consulting, or senior strategic roles within insurance or financial services. jobs.description: Amazon Devices is strengthening its electro-mechanical supply chain in China. We are hiring a Supplier Quality Manager to take end-to-end ownership of quality for the embodied robot commodities — including actuator, connector/harness, mechanical parts (vacuum casting, 3D printing, CNN and plastic injection), battery and electronics/PCBA — across a supplier base spanning Mainland China, Taiwan region, and Southeast Asia, supporting device final assembly lines. This role focuses on four core areas of work: 1). New Product Introduction (NPI) & Supplier Qualification • Lead new supplier qualification audits and on-site capability assessments (process, capacity, quality systems) across CNC machining, injection molding, vacuum casting, 3D printing, PCBA, cables, batteries, and actuators. • Evaluate supplier readiness for volume ramp — quality controls, inspection methods, and process capability at increasing volumes • Drive PPAP management and validate process capability (Cpk/Ppk), high-speed signal integrity, and reliability testing — owning every quality gate before next milestone • Provide on-the-ground quality support during EVT, DVT, and production builds (readiness checks, in-line monitoring, shipment sign-off) 2). Quality Management & Process Control • Define the supplier quality framework — assessment criteria, FAI requirements, process control expectations, nonconformance procedures, and corrective action standards • Establish inspection standards and acceptance criteria per part family (cosmetic standards, dimensional tolerances, material specs, functional test requirements) • Review and validate supplier process controls — SPC, Cpk, control plans, FMEA, poka-yoke — ensuring adequacy for production volumes • Verify supplier traceability systems, material certifications, and lot-level documentation • Manage supplier 5M1E changes, ECN/PCN quality-impact assessments (especially raw-material substitution), and change management for material, process, tooling, or sub-tier changes 3). Nonconformance Resolution & Crisis Response • Lead supplier nonconformance investigations — drive root cause analysis (8D, 5-Why, fishbone) ensuring corrective actions address true root cause, not just containment • Manage containment actions (sorting, 100% inspection, hold/release decisions) to protect production while root cause is resolved • Respond rapidly to line-down events, ship-holds, and customer field issues — driving containment, RCA, and 8D closure, including complex non-reproducible, multi-factor defect escapes 4). Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Alignment • Partner with FATP / IQC teams, US headquarters Hardware R&D, Sourcing, Reliability, etc. • Drive bidirectional optimization between design and process • Establish IQC standards, SCAR routing, and escalation paths • Align inspection methods and acceptance criteria across suppliers and internal teams to ensure consistency from incoming quality through final assembly

jobs.description: L'opportunité Vous serez responsable d’une plateforme sur laquelle les équipes de développement de Unity comptent pour exploiter des services en production. Celle-ci leur fournit un environnement Kubernetes géré dans des grappes partagées afin qu’elles puissent déployer et exploiter des applications sans avoir à mettre en place leur propre infrastructure. Elle prend actuellement en charge plus de 1 200 déploiements actifs et traite environ 30 millions de requêtes entrantes en production par jour. Il s’agit d’un poste principal, et cette distinction est importante. Vous définirez l’orientation technique de la plateforme plutôt que de mettre en œuvre la conception de quelqu’un d’autre. Vous déterminerez la façon de gérer l’architecture multilocataire, l’isolation et la conformité dans les grappes partagées, ainsi que les fonctions que la plateforme doit ou ne doit pas offrir. Vous veillerez ensuite à concrétiser ces décisions en production. Votre jugement influencera la manière dont des centaines de développeur(euse)s chez Unity livrent leur code. L’équipe est répartie dans le monde entier, et les outils que nous créons constituent la base sur laquelle les autres équipes s’appuient pour mettre leur travail en production de façon sûre et rapide. Nous sommes convaincu(e)s que rien de valable ne se construit en vase clos. Ce que vous allez faire Assurer la responsabilité de l’architecture et de la fiabilité d’une plateforme Kubernetes multilocataire : isolation des locataires, application des politiques, contrôle des admissions, attribution des coûts, conformité à la loi SOX et mise à l’échelle des grappes partagées à mesure que leur adoption augmente. Concevoir et livrer des fonctionnalités de plateforme, de la proposition initiale jusqu’à l’exploitation en production. Parmi les exemples récents figurent la gestion des secrets avec Vault, l’application des politiques au moyen de Kyverno, la migration de nginx-ingress vers la Gateway API, la mise à l’échelle automatique axée sur les événements avec KEDA, les ressources Config Connector, un fournisseur d’identité dédié à l’authentification de la plateforme et l’attribution des coûts par espace de noms. Définir l’orientation de la normalisation de l’infrastructure infonuagique chez Unity : déterminer quelles charges de travail conviennent à une plateforme partagée, quelles solutions de rechange sont possibles et comment les équipes peuvent effectuer la transition. Collaborer avec la haute direction ainsi qu’avec les équipes partenaires responsables de l’expérience des développeur(euse)s, des réseaux, des FinOps, de la fiabilité et de la sécurité afin de façonner la feuille de route de la plateforme et de démontrer la pertinence d’y investir. Rehausser les normes de développement au sein de l’équipe grâce à l’examen de la conception et du code ainsi qu’au mentorat. Collaborer directement avec les équipes qui utilisent la plateforme afin de cerner leurs obstacles et de les transformer en améliorations à la plateforme plutôt qu’en interventions ponctuelles répétées. Participer à une rotation de garde pour la plateforme dont vous êtes responsable. Posséder une solide expérience de GCP ainsi qu’une connaissance pratique d’au moins un autre fournisseur, soit AWS ou Azure. Comprendre les compromis liés aux services gérés et être en mesure de défendre une décision architecturale qui touche d’autres équipes que la vôtre. Avoir fait ses preuves dans la prise en charge complète de fonctionnalités de plateforme, notamment dans les domaines de la gestion des secrets, de l’application des politiques, des pipelines de déploiement, de l’identité, de l’attribution des coûts ou du renforcement de la sécurité. Tenir compte de l’expérience des développeur(euse)s qui utilisent vos solutions et accorder la priorité aux travaux qui réduisent les obstacles et favorisent l’adoption des fonctions libre-service. Avoir aidé d’autres équipes à atteindre un haut niveau de résilience des services en transmettant des pratiques et en appliquant les principes de développement axés sur la fiabilité au moyen des outils que vous avez créés. Privilégier l’automatisation plutôt que le travail manuel et créer des systèmes reproductibles, observables et documentés. jobs.description: ABOUT THE TEAM The B2B Marketing team contributes to OpenAI's broader mission of ensuring responsible and widespread adoption of artificial intelligence. We are responsible for developing and executing strategies that drive awareness, engagement, and usage for OpenAI's products and platform. We take a data-driven approach to understand our customers' needs and challenges, ensuring that their voices are reflected in product development and messaging. We then partner closely with Product, Engineering, Growth, Sales, Research, Comms, and Design teams to create a cohesive customer experience across all our channels. ABOUT THE ROLE We're looking for an enterprise Product Marketing Manager to own the administrator and governance experience across ChatGPT Work and Codex. IT administrators, security teams, and deployment owners are often the difference between an AI product being available and an organization actually putting it to work. This role will define how OpenAI earns the trust of the people responsible for approving, deploying, managing, and expanding AI inside their organizations. You will translate a fast-moving set of enterprise capabilities into a clear, practical story covering setup, access, controls, governance, security, usage, and value. You will own the administrator audience as a dedicated product marketing discipline, partnering closely with Product, Security, Sales, Customer Success, Growth, Customer Education, and other Marketing teams. Your job is not simply to announce new features. It is to help administrators understand what has changed, what they can control, how to deploy responsibly, and why expanding access is the right decision for their organization. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: - Own the IT administrator and governance audience: Build a deep understanding of the needs, decisions, objections, and workflows of workspace administrators, IT leaders, security teams, and enterprise deployment owners. - Define the enterprise administration and governance story: Develop clear positioning and messaging across workspace setup, feature enablement, identity and access, roles and permissions, data and connector access, agent controls, auditability, analytics, and spend management. - Lead administrator-focused product launches: Shape launch strategy, messaging, and readiness for capabilities that affect administration, deployment, governance, or control across ChatGPT Work and Codex. - Make product changes understandable and actionable: Build a predictable administrator communications motion that explains what is changing, who is affected, what decisions or actions are required, and how customers can enable new capabilities responsibly. - Create the materials that unblock deployment: Partner with Product, Security, Documentation, and customer-facing teams on practical setup guidance, governance explainers, deployment resources, FAQs, demos, and field enablement. - Turn administrator insight into better product decisions: Bring recurring customer objections, implementation barriers, security questions, and adoption patterns back to Product and Engineering to inform priorities and roadmap tradeoffs. - Build always-on administrator education and engagement: Develop coordinated programs across customer communications, webinars, peer learning, customer stories, lifecycle campaigns, and relevant in-product experiences. - Connect administrative approval to broader adoption: Partner with Growth, Sales, Customer Success, and product marketing peers to move organizations from evaluation and approval to enablement, rollout, and sustained usage. - Earn trust through accuracy and customer proof: Clearly distinguish available capabilities from future plans, represent controls and limitations honestly, and develop evidence that helps administrators make the case for responsible expansion. - Measure administrator and deployment outcomes: Track the signals that matter, including eligible workspace enablement, time to deployment, adoption of relevant controls, field objections, administrator engagement, and confidence in enterprise readiness.
